author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
Having broken through the Eternal Dynasty lines, the Colonel Harris and the HDF are loose in the underground base that is the final redoubt of the Dynasty forces. Hell-bent of securing an AI capable of computing their jump coordinates, the humans offer no quarter to the alien defenders. 

Check out all the rules free HERE: https://onepagerules.com/games/grimdark-future
